verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
Ta Sin Mim.[✛]
These are verses of the clear Book.

verses.ar: لَعَلَّکَ بَاخِعٌ نَّفۡسَکَ اَلَّا یَکُوۡنُوۡا مُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۴﴾
verses.en: Haply thou wilt grieve thyself to death because they believe not.

verses.ar: اِنۡ نَّشَاۡ نُنَزِّلۡ عَلَیۡہِمۡ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ اٰیَۃً فَظَلَّتۡ اَعۡنَاقُہُمۡ لَہَا خٰضِعِیۡنَ ﴿۵﴾
verses.en: If We please, We can send down to them a Sign from the heaven, so that their necks will bow down before it.

verses.ar: وَمَا یَاۡتِیۡہِمۡ مِّنۡ ذِکۡرٍ مِّنَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ مُحۡدَثٍ اِلَّا کَانُوۡا عَنۡہُ مُعۡرِضِیۡنَ ﴿۶﴾
verses.en: And there comes not to them a new Reminder from the Gracious God, but they turn away from it.

verses.ar: فَقَدۡ کَذَّبُوۡا فَسَیَاۡتِیۡہِمۡ اَنۡۢبٰٓؤُا مَا کَانُوۡا بِہٖ یَسۡتَہۡزِءُوۡنَ ﴿۷﴾
verses.en: They have, indeed, treated it as a lie, but soon there will come to them the tidings of that at which they mocked.
w: they have treated it as a lie
but soon there will come to them

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ یَرَوۡا اِلَی الۡاَرۡضِ کَمۡ اَنۡۢبَتۡنَا فِیۡہَا مِنۡ کُلِّ زَوۡجٍ کَرِیۡمٍ ﴿۸﴾
verses.en: Have they not looked at the earth, how many of every noble species have We caused to grow therein?

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِیۡ ذٰلِکَ لَاٰیَۃً ؕ وَمَا کَانَ اَکۡثَرُہُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۹﴾
verses.en: In that there is a Sign indeed; but most of these would not believe.
And verily, thy Lord — He is the Mighty, the Merciful.

verses.ar: وَاِذۡ نَادٰی رَبُّکَ مُوۡسٰۤی اَنِ ائۡتِ الۡقَوۡمَ الظّٰلِمِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۱۱﴾
verses.en: And remember when thy Lord called Moses, saying, ‘Go to the wrongdoing people —
‘The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear God?’

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیۡۤ اَخَافُ اَنۡ یُّکَذِّبُوۡنِ ﴿ؕ۱۳﴾
verses.en: He said, ‘My Lord, I fear that they will treat me as a liar;
w: they will treat me as a liar

verses.ar: وَیَضِیۡقُ صَدۡرِیۡ وَلَا یَنۡطَلِقُ لِسَانِیۡ فَاَرۡسِلۡ اِلٰی ہٰرُوۡنَ ﴿۱۴﴾
verses.en: ‘And my breast is straitened and my tongue is not fluent; therefore, send word to Aaron.

verses.ar: وَلَہُمۡ عَلَیَّ ذَنۡۢبٌ فَاَخَافُ اَنۡ یَّقۡتُلُوۡنِ ﴿ۚ۱۵﴾
verses.en: [✲]‘And they have a charge against me, so I fear that they may kill me.’

verses.ar: قَالَ کَلَّا ۚ فَاذۡہَبَا بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ اِنَّا مَعَکُمۡ مُّسۡتَمِعُوۡنَ ﴿۱۶﴾
verses.en: God said, “Not so, go then, both of you, with Our Signs; We are with you and We hear.

verses.ar: فَاۡتِیَا فِرۡعَوۡنَ فَقُوۡلَاۤ اِنَّا رَسُوۡلُ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۱۷﴾
verses.en: “So go to Pharaoh, and say, ‘We are the Messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
‘To tell thee to send the children of Israel with us.’”

verses.ar: قَالَ اَلَمۡ نُرَبِّکَ فِیۡنَا وَلِیۡدًا وَّلَبِثۡتَ فِیۡنَا مِنۡ عُمُرِکَ سِنِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۱۹﴾
verses.en: Pharaoh said, ‘Did we not bring thee up among us as a child? And thou didst stay among us many years of thy life.

verses.ar: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَکَ الَّتِیۡ فَعَلۡتَ وَاَنۡتَ مِنَ الۡکٰفِرِیۡنَ ﴿۲۰﴾
verses.en: ‘And thou didst do thy deed which thou didst, and thou art of the ungrateful.’

verses.ar: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُہَاۤ اِذًا وَّاَنَا مِنَ الضَّآلِّیۡنَ ﴿ؕ۲۱﴾
verses.en: Moses said, ‘I did do it then, and I was one of the erring.

verses.ar: فَفَرَرۡتُ مِنۡکُمۡ لَمَّا خِفۡتُکُمۡ فَوَہَبَ لِیۡ رَبِّیۡ حُکۡمًا وَّجَعَلَنِیۡ مِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِیۡنَ ﴿۲۲﴾
verses.en: [✲]‘So I fled from you when I feared you; then my Lord granted me right judgment and made me one of the Messengers.

verses.ar: وَتِلۡکَ نِعۡمَۃٌ تَمُنُّہَا عَلَیَّ اَنۡ عَبَّدۡتَّ بَنِیۡۤ اِسۡرَآءِیۡلَ ﴿ؕ۲۳﴾
verses.en: ‘And this is the favour for which thou tauntest me; that thou hast enslaved the children of Israel.’
Pharaoh said, ‘And what is the Lord of the worlds?’

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَیۡنَہُمَا ؕ اِنۡ کُنۡتُمۡ مُّوۡقِنِیۡنَ ﴿۲۵﴾
verses.en: Moses said, ‘The Lord of the heavens and the earth and of all that is between the two, if you would be convinced.’
Pharaoh said to those around him, ‘Do you not hear?’
Moses said, ‘Your Lord, and the Lord of your fathers of yore.’

verses.ar: قَالَ اِنَّ رَسُوۡلَکُمُ الَّذِیۡۤ اُرۡسِلَ اِلَیۡکُمۡ لَمَجۡنُوۡنٌ ﴿۲۸﴾
verses.en: Pharaoh said, ‘Most surely this Messenger of yours who has been sent to you is a madman.’

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ الۡمَشۡرِقِ وَالۡمَغۡرِبِ وَمَا بَیۡنَہُمَا ؕ اِنۡ کُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ ﴿۲۹﴾
verses.en: Moses said, ‘The Lord of the East and of the West, and of all that is between the two, if you did but understand.’

verses.ar: قَالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذۡتَ اِلٰـہًا غَیۡرِیۡ لَاَجۡعَلَنَّکَ مِنَ الۡمَسۡجُوۡنِیۡنَ ﴿۳۰﴾
verses.en: Pharaoh said, ‘If thou takest a God other than me, I will certainly put thee into prison.’
Moses said, ‘What, even though I bring thee something that is manifest!’

verses.ar: قَالَ فَاۡتِ بِہٖۤ اِنۡ کُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِیۡنَ ﴿۳۲﴾
verses.en: Pharaoh said, ‘Bring it then, if thou speakest the truth.’

verses.ar: فَاَلۡقٰی عَصَاہُ فَاِذَا ہِیَ ثُعۡبَانٌ مُّبِیۡنٌ ﴿ۚۖ۳۳﴾
verses.en: So he threw down his rod, and behold! it was a serpent plainly visible.

verses.ar: وَّنَزَعَ یَدَہٗ فَاِذَا ہِیَ بَیۡضَآءُ لِلنّٰظِرِیۡنَ ﴿٪۳۴﴾
verses.en: And he drew forth his hand, and lo! it was white for the beholders.

verses.ar: قَالَ لِلۡمَلَاِ حَوۡلَہٗۤ اِنَّ ہٰذَا لَسٰحِرٌ عَلِیۡمٌ ﴿ۙ۳۵﴾
verses.en: Pharaoh said to the chiefs around him, ‘This is surely a skilful magician.

verses.ar: یُّرِیۡدُ اَنۡ یُّخۡرِجَکُمۡ مِّنۡ اَرۡضِکُمۡ بِسِحۡرِہٖ ٭ۖ فَمَاذَا تَاۡمُرُوۡنَ ﴿۳۶﴾
verses.en: ‘He seeks to turn you out of your land by his magic. Now what do you advise?’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡۤا اَرۡجِہۡ وَاَخَاہُ وَابۡعَثۡ فِی الۡمَدَآئِنِ حٰشِرِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۳۷﴾
verses.en: They said, ‘Put him off and his brother awhile and send into the cities summoners,
‘Who should bring thee every skilful sorcerer.’
So the magicians were assembled together at the appointed time on a fixed day.
And it was said to the people, ‘Will you also gather together,

verses.ar: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَۃَ اِنۡ کَانُوۡا ہُمُ الۡغٰلِبِیۡنَ ﴿۴۱﴾
verses.en: ‘So that we may follow the magicians if they are the winners?’

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ السَّحَرَۃُ قَالُوۡا لِفِرۡعَوۡنَ اَئِنَّ لَنَا لَاَجۡرًا اِنۡ کُنَّا نَحۡنُ الۡغٰلِبِیۡنَ ﴿۴۲﴾
verses.en: And, when the magicians came, they said to Pharaoh, ‘Shall we have a reward if we are the winners?’

verses.ar: قَالَ نَعَمۡ وَاِنَّکُمۡ اِذًا لَّمِنَ الۡمُقَرَّبِیۡنَ ﴿۴۳﴾
verses.en: [✲]He said, ‘Yes, and surely then you will be among those who are near my person.’

verses.ar: قَالَ لَہُمۡ مُّوۡسٰۤی اَلۡقُوۡا مَاۤ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّلۡقُوۡنَ ﴿۴۴﴾
verses.en: Moses said to them, ‘Now throw ye what you have to throw.’

verses.ar: فَاَلۡقَوۡا حِبَالَہُمۡ وَعِصِیَّہُمۡ وَقَالُوۡا بِعِزَّۃِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ اِنَّا لَنَحۡنُ الۡغٰلِبُوۡنَ ﴿۴۵﴾
verses.en: So they threw down their ropes and their rods, and said, ‘By Pharaoh’s honour, it is we who will surely win.’

verses.ar: فَاَلۡقٰی مُوۡسٰی عَصَاہُ فَاِذَا ہِیَ تَلۡقَفُ مَا یَاۡفِکُوۡنَ ﴿ۚۖ۴۶﴾
verses.en: Then Moses threw down his rod, and lo! it swallowed up that which they had fabricated.
Thereupon the magicians were impelled to fall down prostrate.
w: thereupon were impelled to fall down

verses.en: They said, ‘We believe in the Lord of the worlds,
‘The Lord of Moses, and of Aaron.’

verses.ar: قَالَ اٰمَنۡتُمۡ لَہٗ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ اٰذَنَ لَکُمۡ ۚ اِنَّہٗ لَکَبِیۡرُکُمُ الَّذِیۡ عَلَّمَکُمُ السِّحۡرَ ۚ فَلَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ۬ؕ لَاُقَطِّعَنَّ اَیۡدِیَکُمۡ وَاَرۡجُلَکُمۡ مِّنۡ خِلَافٍ وَّلَاُوصَلِّبَنَّکُمۡ اَجۡمَعِیۡنَ ﴿ۚ۵۰﴾
verses.en: Pharaoh said, ‘You have believed in him before I gave you leave? He is surely your chief who has taught you magic. But you shall know the consequences thereof. I will most surely cut off your hands and your feet on alternate sides, and I will most surely crucify you all.’
w: I will most surely cut off
and I will most surely crucify you

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَا ضَیۡرَ ۫ اِنَّاۤ اِلٰی رَبِّنَا مُنۡقَلِبُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۵۱﴾
verses.en: They said, ‘There is no harm; to our lord shall we return.

verses.ar: اِنَّا نَطۡمَعُ اَنۡ یَّغۡفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطٰیٰنَاۤ اَنۡ کُنَّاۤ اَوَّلَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿ؕ٪۵۲﴾
verses.en: ‘We do hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, since we are the first among the believers.’

verses.ar: وَاَوۡحَیۡنَاۤ اِلٰی مُوۡسٰۤی اَنۡ اَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِیۡۤ اِنَّکُمۡ مُّتَّبَعُوۡنَ ﴿۵۳﴾
verses.en: And We revealed to Moses, saying, ‘Take away My servants by night, you will surely be pursued.’
And Pharaoh sent summoners into the cities, saying,
‘These are a small party,
‘And they have offended us;
‘And we are a multitude fully prepared and vigilant.’
So We turned them out of gardens, and springs,
And treasures, and an abode of honour.
Thus indeed it was; and We gave them as heritage to the children of Israel —
w: and We gave them as heritage

verses.en: And they pursued and overtook them at sunrise.
w: and they pursued and overtook them

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَآءَ الۡجَمۡعٰنِ قَالَ اَصۡحٰبُ مُوۡسٰۤی اِنَّا لَمُدۡرَکُوۡنَ ﴿ۚ۶۲﴾
verses.en: And when the two hosts came in sight of each other the companions of Moses said, ‘We are surely overtaken.’
w: came in sight of each other

verses.ar: قَالَ کَلَّا ۚ اِنَّ مَعِیَ رَبِّیۡ سَیَہۡدِیۡنِ ﴿۶۳﴾
verses.en: ‘Nay, speak not thus!’ said he, ‘My Lord is with me. He will direct me aright.’

verses.ar: فَاَوۡحَیۡنَاۤ اِلٰی مُوۡسٰۤی اَنِ اضۡرِبۡ بِّعَصَاکَ الۡبَحۡرَ ؕ فَانۡفَلَقَ فَکَانَ کُلُّ فِرۡقٍ کَالطَّوۡدِ الۡعَظِیۡمِ ﴿ۚ۶۴﴾
verses.en: Then We revealed to Moses, saying, ‘Strike the sea with thy rod.’ Thereupon it parted, and every part looked like a huge mountain.
[✲]And We made others approach that place.
And We saved Moses and those who were with him.
Then We drowned the others.

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِیۡ ذٰلِکَ لَاٰیَۃً ؕ وَمَا کَانَ اَکۡثَرُہُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۶۸﴾
verses.en: In this, verily, there is a Sign; but most of these would not believe.
And surely thy Lord — He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
And recite unto them the story of Abraham.

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لِاَبِیۡہِ وَقَوۡمِہٖ مَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ ﴿۷۱﴾
verses.en: When he said to his father and his people, ‘What do you worship?’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا نَعۡبُدُ اَصۡنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَہَا عٰکِفِیۡنَ ﴿۷۲﴾
verses.en: They said, ‘We worship idols, and we continue to be devoted to them.’
[✲]He said, ‘Can they listen to you when you call on them?
‘Or do you good or harm you?’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا بَلۡ وَجَدۡنَاۤ اٰبَآءَنَا کَذٰلِکَ یَفۡعَلُوۡنَ ﴿۷۵﴾
verses.en: They said, ‘Nay, but we found our fathers doing likewise.’
He said, ‘What think ye of that which you have been worshipping —
‘You and your fathers before you.

verses.ar: فَاِنَّہُمۡ عَدُوٌّ لِّیۡۤ اِلَّا رَبَّ الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۷۸﴾
verses.en: ‘They are all enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds;
‘Who has created me, and it is He Who guides me;
[✲]‘And Who gives me food and gives me drink;
‘And when I am ill, it is He Who restores me to health;
‘And Who will cause me to die, and then bring me to life again;

verses.ar: وَالَّذِیۡۤ اَطۡمَعُ اَنۡ یَّغۡفِرَ لِیۡ خَطِیۡٓئَتِیۡ یَوۡمَ الدِّیۡنِ ﴿ؕ۸۳﴾
verses.en: ‘And Who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Judgment.

verses.ar: رَبِّ ہَبۡ لِیۡ حُکۡمًا وَّاَلۡحِقۡنِیۡ بِالصّٰلِحِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۸۴﴾
verses.en: ‘My Lord, bestow wisdom on me and join me with the righteous;

verses.ar: وَاجۡعَلۡ لِّیۡ لِسَانَ صِدۡقٍ فِی الۡاٰخِرِیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۸۵﴾
verses.en: ‘And give me a true reputation among posterity;
‘And make me one of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss;

verses.ar: وَاغۡفِرۡ لِاَبِیۡۤ اِنَّہٗ کَانَ مِنَ الضَّآلِّیۡنَ ﴿ۙ۸۷﴾
verses.en: ‘And forgive my father; for he is one of the erring;
‘And disgrace me not on the day when they will be raised up,

verses.ar: یَوۡمَ لَا یَنۡفَعُ مَالٌ وَّلَا بَنُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۸۹﴾
verses.en: ‘The day when wealth and sons shall not avail;

verses.ar: اِلَّا مَنۡ اَتَی اللّٰہَ بِقَلۡبٍ سَلِیۡمٍ ﴿ؕ۹۰﴾
verses.en: [✲]‘But he alone will be saved who brings to Allah a sound heart;’
And Heaven shall be brought near to the righteous.
[✲]And Hell shall be opened to those who have gone astray.
w: to those who have gone astray

verses.ar: وَقِیۡلَ لَہُمۡ اَیۡنَ مَا کُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۹۳﴾
verses.en: And it will be said to them, ‘Where is that which you worshipped

verses.ar: مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰہِ ؕ ہَلۡ یَنۡصُرُوۡنَکُمۡ اَوۡ یَنۡتَصِرُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۹۴﴾
verses.en: ‘Beside Allah? Can they help you or get help for themselves?’
Then will they be thrown headlong therein, they and those who have gone astray,
w: then will they be thrown headlong
and those who have gone astray

verses.en: And the hosts of Iblis, all together.
They will say, whilst they dispute between themselves therein:

verses.ar: تَاللّٰہِ اِنۡ کُنَّا لَفِیۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِیۡنٍ ﴿ۙ۹۸﴾
verses.en: ‘By Allah, we were in manifest error,
‘When we held you as equal with the Lord of the worlds;
‘And none led us astray but the guilty ones.
‘And now we have no intercessors,
‘Nor any loving friend.

verses.ar: فَلَوۡ اَنَّ لَنَا کَرَّۃً فَنَکُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۱۰۳﴾
verses.en: ‘Would that there were for us a return to the world, that we might be among the believers!’

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِیۡ ذٰلِکَ لَاٰیَۃً ؕ وَمَا کَانَ اَکۡثَرُہُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۱۰۴﴾
verses.en: In this, verily, there is a Sign, but most of these would not believe.
And verily thy Lord — He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
The people of Noah treated the Messengers as liars,

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَہُمۡ اَخُوۡہُمۡ نُوۡحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ ﴿۱۰۷﴾ۚ
verses.en: When their brother Noah said to them, ‘Will you not be righteous?
[✲]‘Surely, I am unto you a Messenger, faithful to my trust.
‘So fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَاۤ اَسۡـَٔلُکُمۡ عَلَیۡہِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ ۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِیَ اِلَّا عَلٰی رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ ﴿۱۱۰﴾ۚ
verses.en: ‘And I ask of you no reward for it. My reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.
‘So fear Allah, and obey me.’
They said, ‘Shall we believe thee, when it is the meanest that follow thee?’
w: when it is that follow thee

verses.ar: قَالَ وَمَا عِلۡمِیۡ بِمَا کَانُوۡا یَعۡمَلُوۡنَ ﴿۱۱۳﴾ۚ
verses.en: He said, ‘And what knowledge have I as to what they have been doing?

verses.ar: اِنۡ حِسَابُہُمۡ اِلَّا عَلٰی رَبِّیۡ لَوۡ تَشۡعُرُوۡنَ ﴿۱۱۴﴾ۚ
verses.en: ‘Their account is only with my Lord, if you only knew!
‘And I am not going to drive away the believers.
‘I am only a plain Warner.’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَہِ یٰنُوۡحُ لَتَکُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡمَرۡجُوۡمِیۡنَ ﴿۱۱۷﴾ؕ
verses.en: They said, ‘If thou desist not, O Noah, thou shalt surely be one of those who are stoned.’
He said, ‘My Lord, my people have treated me as a liar.
w: have treated me as a liar

verses.ar: فَافۡتَحۡ بَیۡنِیۡ وَبَیۡنَہُمۡ فَتۡحًا وَّنَجِّنِیۡ وَمَنۡ مَّعِیَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۱۱۹﴾
verses.en: ‘Therefore judge Thou decisively between me and them; and save me and the believers that are with me.’

verses.ar: فَاَنۡجَیۡنٰہُ وَمَنۡ مَّعَہٗ فِی الۡفُلۡکِ الۡمَشۡحُوۡنِ ﴿۱۲۰﴾ۚ
verses.en: So We saved him, and those who were with him in the fully laden Ark.
Then We drowned thereafter those who remained behind.

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِیۡ ذٰلِکَ لَاٰیَۃً ؕ وَمَا کَانَ اَکۡثَرُہُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۱۲۲﴾
verses.en: In this, verily, there is a Sign, but most of them would not believe.
And verily thy Lord — He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
The tribe of ‘Ad rejected the Messengers,

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَہُمۡ اَخُوۡہُمۡ ہُوۡدٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ ﴿۱۲۵﴾ۚ
verses.en: When their brother Hud said to them, ‘Will you not be righteous?
[✲]‘Surely, I am unto you a Messenger, faithful to my trust.
‘So fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَاۤ اَسۡـَٔلُکُمۡ عَلَیۡہِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ ۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِیَ اِلَّا عَلٰی رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ ﴿۱۲۸﴾ؕ
verses.en: ‘And I ask of you no reward for it. My reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.
‘Do you build monuments on every high place seeking vain glory,
[✲]‘And do you erect palaces as though you will live forever?
‘And when you lay hands upon any one, you lay hands as tyrants.
‘So fear Allah, and obey me.
‘And fear Him Who has helped you with all that you know.
‘He has helped you with cattle, and sons,
‘And gardens, and springs.

verses.ar: اِنِّیۡۤ اَخَافُ عَلَیۡکُمۡ عَذَابَ یَوۡمٍ عَظِیۡمٍ ﴿۱۳۶﴾ؕ
verses.en: [✲]‘Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of an awful day.’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا سَوَآءٌ عَلَیۡنَاۤ اَوَعَظۡتَ اَمۡ لَمۡ تَکُنۡ مِّنَ الۡوٰعِظِیۡنَ ﴿۱۳۷﴾ۙ
verses.en: They said, ‘It is the same to us whether thou admonish us or whether thou be not of those who admonish.’
‘This is nothing but a habit of the ancients,
‘And we shall not be punished.’

verses.ar: فَکَذَّبُوۡہُ فَاَہۡلَکۡنٰہُمۡ ؕ اِنَّ فِیۡ ذٰلِکَ لَاٰیَۃً ؕ وَمَا کَانَ اَکۡثَرُہُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۱۴۰﴾
verses.en: So they rejected him, and We destroyed them. In that indeed there is a Sign, but most of these would not believe.
And verily thy Lord — He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
The tribe of Thamud rejected the Messengers,

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَہُمۡ اَخُوۡہُمۡ صٰلِحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ ﴿۱۴۳﴾ۚ
verses.en: When their brother Salih said to them, ‘Will you not be righteous?
[✲]‘Surely, I am unto you a Messenger, faithful to my trust.
‘So fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَاۤ اَسۡـَٔلُکُمۡ عَلَیۡہِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ ۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِیَ اِلَّا عَلٰی رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ ﴿۱۴۶﴾ؕ
verses.en: ‘And I ask of you no reward for it. My reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.
‘Will you be left secure amid the things that you have here,
‘Amid gardens and springs,
[✲]‘And cornfields, and datepalms with heavy spathes near breaking?
‘And you hew out houses in the mountains with great skill.
‘So fear Allah, and obey me.
‘And obey not the bidding of those who exceed the bounds,
w: of those who exceed the bounds

verses.ar: الَّذِیۡنَ یُفۡسِدُوۡنَ فِی الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا یُصۡلِحُوۡنَ ﴿۱۵۳﴾
verses.en: ‘Who create disorder in the earth, and reform it not.’
They said, ‘Thou art but one of the bewitched;

verses.ar: مَاۤ اَنۡتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُنَا ۚۖ فَاۡتِ بِاٰیَۃٍ اِنۡ کُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِیۡنَ ﴿۱۵۵﴾
verses.en: ‘Thou art only a man like ourselves. So bring a Sign, if thou art one of the truthful.’

verses.ar: قَالَ ہٰذِہٖ نَاقَۃٌ لَّہَا شِرۡبٌ وَّلَکُمۡ شِرۡبُ یَوۡمٍ مَّعۡلُوۡمٍ ﴿۱۵۶﴾ۚ
verses.en: He said, ‘Here is a she-camel: she has her turn of drinking, and you have your turn of drinking on an appointed day.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَمَسُّوۡہَا بِسُوۡٓءٍ فَیَاۡخُذَکُمۡ عَذَابُ یَوۡمٍ عَظِیۡمٍ ﴿۱۵۷﴾
verses.en: [✲]‘And touch her not with evil lest there overtake you the punishment of an awful day.’
But they hamstrung her; and then they became regretful.

verses.ar: فَاَخَذَہُمُ الۡعَذَابُ ؕ اِنَّ فِیۡ ذٰلِکَ لَاٰیَۃً ؕ وَمَا کَانَ اَکۡثَرُہُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۱۵۹﴾
verses.en: So the punishment overtook them. In that verily there is a Sign, but most of these would not believe.
And surely thy Lord — He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
The people of Lot rejected the Messengers,

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَہُمۡ اَخُوۡہُمۡ لُوۡطٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ ﴿۱۶۲﴾ۚ
verses.en: When their brother Lot said to them, ‘Will you not become righteous?
[✲]‘Surely, I am unto you a Messenger, faithful to my trust.
‘So fear Allah, and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَاۤ اَسۡـَٔلُکُمۡ عَلَیۡہِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ ۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِیَ اِلَّا عَلٰی رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ ﴿۱۶۵﴾ؕ
verses.en: ‘And I ask of you no reward for it. My reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.
‘Do you, of all peoples, approach males,

verses.ar: وَتَذَرُوۡنَ مَا خَلَقَ لَکُمۡ رَبُّکُمۡ مِّنۡ اَزۡوَاجِکُمۡ ؕ بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عٰدُوۡنَ ﴿۱۶۷﴾
verses.en: ‘And leave your wives whom your Lord has created for you? Nay, you are a people who transgress.’

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَہِ یٰلُوۡطُ لَتَکُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡمُخۡرَجِیۡنَ ﴿۱۶۸﴾
verses.en: They said, ‘If thou desist not, O Lot, thou wilt surely be one of the banished ones.’
[✲]He said, ‘Certainly I hate your practice.
‘My Lord, save me and my family from what they do.’
So We saved him and his family, all of them,
Save an old woman among those who stayed behind.
Then We destroyed the others.

verses.ar: وَاَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَیۡہِمۡ مَّطَرًا ۚ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ الۡمُنۡذَرِیۡنَ ﴿۱۷۴﴾
verses.en: [✲]And We rained upon them a rain; and evil was the rain for those who were warned.

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِیۡ ذٰلِکَ لَاٰیَۃً ؕ وَمَا کَانَ اَکۡثَرُہُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۱۷۵﴾
verses.en: In that verily there is a Sign, but most of these would not believe.
And surely thy Lord — He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
The People of the Wood rejected the Messengers,

verses.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ لَہُمۡ شُعَیۡبٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُوۡنَ ﴿۱۷۸﴾ۚ
verses.en: When Shu‘aib said to them, ‘Will you not be righteous?
[✲]‘Surely, I am unto you a Messenger, faithful to my trust.
‘So fear Allah, and obey me,

verses.ar: وَمَاۤ اَسۡـَٔلُکُمۡ عَلَیۡہِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍ ۚ اِنۡ اَجۡرِیَ اِلَّا عَلٰی رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِیۡنَ ﴿۱۸۱﴾ؕ
verses.en: ‘And I ask of you no reward for it. My reward is only with the Lord of the worlds.

verses.ar: اَوۡفُوا الۡکَیۡلَ وَلَا تَکُوۡنُوۡا مِنَ الۡمُخۡسِرِیۡنَ ﴿۱۸۲﴾ۚ
verses.en: ‘Give full measure, and be not of those who give less,
[✲]‘And weigh with a true balance,

verses.ar: وَلَا تَبۡخَسُوا النَّاسَ اَشۡیَآءَہُمۡ وَلَا تَعۡثَوۡا فِی الۡاَرۡضِ مُفۡسِدِیۡنَ ﴿۱۸۴﴾ۚ
verses.en: [✲]‘And diminish not unto people their things, nor act corruptly in the earth, making mischief.
[✲]‘And fear Him Who created you and the earlier peoples.’
They said, ‘Thou art but one of the bewitched.

verses.ar: وَمَاۤ اَنۡتَ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُنَا وَاِنۡ نَّظُنُّکَ لَمِنَ الۡکٰذِبِیۡنَ ﴿۱۸۷﴾ۚ
verses.en: ‘And thou art only a man like ourselves, and we believe thee to be one of the liars.

verses.ar: فَاَسۡقِطۡ عَلَیۡنَا کِسَفًا مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ اِنۡ کُنۡتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِیۡنَ ﴿۱۸۸﴾ؕ
verses.en: ‘So cause fragments of the sky to fall on us, if thou art one of the truthful.’
He said, ‘My Lord knows best what you do.’

verses.ar: فَکَذَّبُوۡہُ فَاَخَذَہُمۡ عَذَابُ یَوۡمِ الظُّلَّۃِ ؕ اِنَّہٗ کَانَ عَذَابَ یَوۡمٍ عَظِیۡمٍ ﴿۱۹۰﴾
verses.en: So they declared him to be a liar. Then the punishment of the day of overshadowing gloom overtook them. That was indeed the punishment of a dreadful day.
w: so they declared him to be a liar

verses.ar: اِنَّ فِیۡ ذٰلِکَ لَاٰیَۃً ؕ وَمَا کَانَ اَکۡثَرُہُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۱۹۱﴾
verses.en: In that verily there is a Sign, but most of these would not believe.
And surely thy Lord — He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
And verily this is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
The Spirit, Faithful to the Trust, has descended with it.
On thy heart, that thou mayest be of the Warners,
In plain and clear Arabic tongue.
And it is surely mentioned in the Scriptures of the former peoples.

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ یَکُنۡ لَّہُمۡ اٰیَۃً اَنۡ یَّعۡلَمَہٗ عُلَمٰٓؤُا بَنِیۡۤ اِسۡرَآءِیۡلَ ﴿۱۹۸﴾ؕ
verses.en: And is it not a Sign to them that the learned among the children of Israel know it?
[✲]And if We had sent it down to one of the non-Arabs,

verses.ar: فَقَرَاَہٗ عَلَیۡہِمۡ مَّا کَانُوۡا بِہٖ مُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۲۰۰﴾ؕ
verses.en: [✲]And he had read it to them, even then they would never have believed in it.
Thus have We caused it (disbelief) to enter into the hearts of the sinful.
w: have We caused it (disbelief) to enter

verses.ar: لَا یُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِہٖ حَتّٰی یَرَوُا الۡعَذَابَ الۡاَلِیۡمَ ﴿۲۰۲﴾ۙ
verses.en: They will not believe in it until they see the grievous punishment.
But it will come upon them suddenly, while they know not,
w: but it will come upon them

verses.en: And they will say, ‘Shall we be given any respite?’
What! do they seek to hasten Our punishment?
What thinkest thou? If We let them enjoy the good things of this world for years;
w: We let them enjoy the good things of this world

verses.en: Then there comes to them that with which they are threatened.

verses.ar: مَاۤ اَغۡنٰی عَنۡہُمۡ مَّا کَانُوۡا یُمَتَّعُوۡنَ ﴿۲۰۸﴾ؕ
verses.en: Of no avail shall be to them that which they were allowed to enjoy.

verses.ar: وَمَاۤ اَہۡلَکۡنَا مِنۡ قَرۡیَۃٍ اِلَّا لَہَا مُنۡذِرُوۡنَ ﴿۲۰۹﴾٭ۖۛ
verses.en: And never did We destroy any township but it had Warners.
This is an admonition; and We are not unjust.
And the evil ones have not brought it down.
[✲]They are not fit for it, nor have they the power to do so.
w: have they the power to do so

verses.en: Surely they are debarred from hearing.

verses.ar: فَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ اللّٰہِ اِلٰـہًا اٰخَرَ فَتَکُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُعَذَّبِیۡنَ ﴿۲۱۴﴾ۚ
verses.en: Call not, therefore, on any other God beside Allah, lest thou become one of those who are punished.
And warn thy nearest kinsmen,

verses.ar: وَاخۡفِضۡ جَنَاحَکَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَکَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِیۡنَ ﴿۲۱۶﴾ۚ
verses.en: And lower thy wing of mercy to the believers who follow thee.

verses.ar: فَاِنۡ عَصَوۡکَ فَقُلۡ اِنِّیۡ بَرِیۡٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ ﴿۲۱۷﴾ۚ
verses.en: Then if they disobey thee, say, ‘I repudiate all connection with what you do.’
And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful,
Who sees thee when thou standest up in Prayer.
And Who sees thy movements among those who prostrate themselves before God.
He is indeed the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

verses.ar: ہَلۡ اُنَبِّئُکُمۡ عَلٰی مَنۡ تَنَزَّلُ الشَّیٰطِیۡنُ ﴿۲۲۲﴾ؕ
verses.en: Shall I inform you on whom the evil ones descend?
They descend on every great liar and sinner,
Repeating what they hear, and most of them are liars.
And as for the poets — it is the erring ones who follow them.

verses.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اَنَّہُمۡ فِیۡ کُلِّ وَادٍ یَّہِیۡمُوۡنَ ﴿۲۲۶﴾ۙ
verses.en: Dost thou not see how they wander distracted in every valley,
And that they say what they practise not? —

verses.ar: اِلَّا الَّذِیۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَذَکَرُوا اللّٰہَ کَثِیۡرًا وَّانۡتَصَرُوۡا مِنۡۢ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُوۡا ؕ وَسَیَعۡلَمُ الَّذِیۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡۤا اَیَّ مُنۡقَلَبٍ یَّنۡقَلِبُوۡنَ ﴿۲۲۸﴾٪
verses.en: Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and retaliate only after they are wronged. And the wrongdoers will soon know to what place of return they shall return.
